desc: Carry pistol features a beveled magwell, forged slide with double serrations, Match aluminum speed trigger, throated barrel, Dovetail front sights with Tritium inserts and rear sight with Tritium inserts. Other features are a flat mainspring housing with LPI checkering; 25 LPI checkered front strap; Commander hammer and sear; beavertail grip with raised pad; lowered and flared ejection port; tuned and polished extended extractor; tactical mag catch and safety; standard recoil system; dehorned for carry; tuned for total reliability.
